plain: Not decided or fixed; not yet worked out

example.quote: Thus was a single province obliged to bear almost the whole burdens of the war ; and, one hundred years after, the accounts of this war were unsettled.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. KING, January 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
